description: The strings the CLI and TUI tabs are allowed to show. Every line and prompt in src/cli.js, and every label, note, result and key binding in src/tui.js, has to match one of these; verify/check.py fails the build on one that matches none. Each entry names the mov source that prints it, so when mov's wording changes this is the one file to update and the source says where to look. The coupling is by reference: the two repositories cannot see each other's tests, and this file is the honest substitute. What the operator types and what mov generates from it are free text and are not held to this.

formats.source: an ARM resource type, as the catalogue lists it
mov/src/mov/new/flow.py  Flow._select: the origin under a pick
mov/src/mov/new/flow.py  _origin: a parent type that came along with its child
mov/src/mov/new/screens.py  BINDINGS descriptions on the four screens
mov/src/mov/new/forms.py  a question's title is the schema property name
mov/src/mov/new/flow.py  questions_for: the note on a required envelope member

formats.pattern: ^this becomes the env: letters and digits, e\.g\. selfhosted$
^More entries, tags and overrides belong in the file itself -- it is yours to edit before anything deploys\.$

formats.source: mov/src/mov/cli.py  new: the stages line under the write
mov/src/mov/cli.py  new: the two typer.confirm prompts, answered
mov/src/mov/runner.py  the stage heading: n/total name summary

formats.pattern: ^ {5}would deploy mov-\S+( into a new resource group)?$
